title: One Piece Confirms 2027 Return for New Episodes After Season Finale
content: One Piece has officially come to an end for the year, and has now confirmed it’s going to be returning for new episodes of the TV anime in 2027. One Piece ushered in an entirely new era of the anime’s production this year.
author: ComicBook

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Cour 2 Officially Announced
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 anime announced a Cour 2 after Episode 14 finished airing on September 27. The anime entered its darkest episodes yet with the introduction of future Rudeus and his diary , with the latest episode concluding the arc.
author: Anime Corner

title: One Piece Anime to Continue in 2027, Finished for This Year After Episode 1180
content: ONE PIECE TV anime announced a 2027 return following the release of Episode 1180 , this year’s final episode, on September 27. The anime has concluded its run for this year, having returned after a 3-month break on April 5.
author: Anime Corner

title: Welcome to Demon School Iruma-kun to Return With New Movie – Watch Teaser
content: Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun has just wrapped up its fourth season, and the franchise has confirmed it’s now in the works on coming back with its feature film debut. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has officially kicked off this week as the earliest premieres are starting to hit, and that means it’s time to say…
author: ComicBook

title: Killing Bites' Shinya Murata Launches New Fantasy Ninja Manga
content: Kadokawa announced on Friday Shinya Murata launched a new manga series with Daichi Matsuse titled Shinoblade SHINOBI BLADE in Kadokawa and Kakao Piccoma 's "Manga BAR" e-manga magazine on the same day. Murata will write and storyboard the series while Matsuse will provide the art.
author: ANN

title: New 'Monster Strike: Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijou na Koi' Announced for Winter 2027
content: Game publisher and developer Mixi announced a new television anime adaptation for the Monster Strike smartphone role-playing game, subtitled Monster Strike: Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijou na Koi ( Mera×Death: The Unusual Love Between Me and the Grim Reaper ) on Sunday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: One Peace Books Adds 'My Life Turned Around: After I Was Betrayed and Framed, I Won the Heart of the Most Beautiful Girl at School' Manga
content: One Peace Books describes its story: The day he lost everything was the day he met her. At the end of summer, Eiji Aono witnesses the unthinkable: his childhood friend and girlfriend, Miyuki Amada, cheating on him with Kondo, the ace of the school's soccer team.
author: ANN

title: Monster Strike Franchise Gets New Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijō na Koi TV Anime Starting on January 5
content: MIXI announced on Sunday a new anime in the Monster Strike franchise titled Mera×Death: Shinigami to Boku no Ijō na Koi (Mera×Death: The Unusual Love Between Me and the Grim Reaper), which will debut in Japan on January 5, 2027 on TOKYO MX and 10 other channels, as well as on streaming services.
author: ANN

title: 'Mairimashita! Iruma-kun' Anime Movie Announced
content: The Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ( Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun ) special event "Devils Party 2" announced an anime movie project for the franchise on Sunday. The official website also revealed an announcement image (pictured above) and announcement promo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun First Theatrical Anime Film Project Announced
content: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun is getting its first theatrical anime film project. The project announcement video was revealed during the DEVIL’S PARTY! 2 event held at Nippon Engineering College Arena in Tokyo on September 27.
author: Anime Corner
